question: What kind of woman was the grandmother?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Religious**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The last sentence of the second paragraph says "***She** did not believe in the things they taught at the English school and **was distressed that there was no teaching about God and the scriptures***''. (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है दादी उन बातों पर विश्वास नहीं करती थी जो वे अंग्रेजी स्कूल में पढ़ाते थे और व्यथित थी कि भगवान और शास्त्रों के बारे में कोई शिक्षण नहीं था)
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that the grandmother was a religious woman. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से हम कह सकते हैं कि दादी एक धार्मिक महिला थीं)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 4.

73:Taa8,

The correct answer is '**He and his grandmother shifting to the city**.'
